forecast.author: MIST
forecast.method: Each median starts at the unit-normalized consensus (ESPN, Sleeper, CBS, FantasyPros, FFToday and the sportsbook props where posted; most props are not up on Tuesday) times the tier median from the residual library, with the 50 and 90 widths from the tier quantiles. Hand moves are on probation (closing line value sign agreement 0.47 on 34 moves), so no median leaves its anchor on a hunch. The two questionable players (Christian Watson, ribs; David Montgomery, groin) have no practice line yet and are priced as a mixture: 0.71 to play, 0.91 of the line when playing, a zero otherwise. The week 7 alarm (q75-q95 slice at 37%) is not acted on by hand: the q75 rebuild test from an interactive session is still not run, so the bands stay at the library's widths. The pending Adonai Mitchell for Josh Downs claim (Wed 2:00 AM) is not on the roster and is not in these lines.
